# Help with Coigüe

The [documentation](https://fclaude.github.io/coigue/) covers
[getting started](https://fclaude.github.io/coigue/setup/),
[using the editor](https://fclaude.github.io/coigue/using/),
[keys and commands](https://fclaude.github.io/coigue/keys/), and
[writing extensions](https://fclaude.github.io/coigue/writing/).

For a bug or a documentation problem, [open an issue](https://github.com/fclaude/coigue/issues).
Report security problems as described in [the security policy](../SECURITY.md).
